claims.label: CodeHawks First Flights — leaderboard rank, point-in-time
claims.evidence_pointer: owner-attested — dated CodeHawks/Cyfrin stats cards (4 Nov 2025 -> 12 Jan 2026, rising). Contest-level corroboration: Cyfrin's official reports for First Flights #42, #49 and #52 credit agilegypsy as a validated submitter on seven findings (see codehawks-validated-findings)
claims.reconciliation_note: Corrected 2026-08-23 from '#124', which was live on the homepage and WRONG. The owner's First Flights profile reads Rank #152. A rank is RELATIVE — it moves when other researchers earn EXP, with no action by the holder: #137 (Nov 2025) -> #124 (Jan 2026) -> #152 (Aug 2026). It is therefore date-stamped IN THE VALUE, because a relative number with no as-of silently becomes a false claim, which is exactly what happened here. RECOMMENDATION ON RECORD: lead with EXP and valid submissions, which are the owner's own and monotonic, and treat rank as supporting colour. Downgraded from a URL receipt 2026-08-23. The pointer was https://profiles.cyfrin.io/u/agilegypsy, which renders as a clickable 'View the receipt' link. That page today shows 'Ranking: Unranked', 'Total Findings High 0 Med 0 Low 0' and '0 USDC' to a logged-out visitor — it CONTRADICTS the claim it was cited for. codehawks.cyfrin.io/profile/agilegypsy redirects to /contests, /u/agilegypsy 404s, and profiles.cyfrin.io/u/agilegypsy/codehawks redirects to /login, so Cyfrin appears to gate or to have dropped public competition stats. The CREDENTIAL is unaffected and documented (mas/facts/PORTFOLIO_REFERENCE.md 1b: two dated stats cards showing the trend, plus a written contest report). Only the receipt was broken, and a broken receipt on an auditor's headline credential is worse than no receipt. Restore the URL the moment Cyfrin shows the record publicly again. ✎ 2026-08-23, second correction: this pointer first said 'the full First Flight #42 contest report on file', which implied that report evidences John's record. It does not — it is Cyfrin's compilation of ~70 researchers, and the published H-01/M-01 write-ups are credited to nomadic_bear and robercano. It DOES credit agilegypsy as a validated submitter on both, which is what the pointer now says. See mas/facts/PORTFOLIO_REFERENCE.md 1b.

claims.evidence_pointer: owner-attested — Cyfrin's official contest reports for First Flights #42, #43, #48, #49, #50, #51 and #52 list agilegypsy in the validated-submitter set for each finding named on the surface
claims.reconciliation_note: Widened to 12 across 6 on 2026-08-23, from the #43 and #53 official reports the owner supplied. #43 OrderBook added ONE finding (L-03, missing event indexing, Low). #53 RebateFi Hook yielded ZERO — agilegypsy appears in none of its seven submitter lists — and that null result is recorded rather than left blank, because 'checked, found nothing' and 'not checked' are different facts and only one of them means this figure is complete. #48 stays unknown: its results page says judging and appeals are still in progress. Accounted: 12 of the profile's 17 (8H/5M/4L); the outstanding 3H/1M/1L are presumably #48 plus contests without reports on disk. ✎ Re-derived from disk 2026-08-23: all three reports are now in the audit tree and `npm run codehawks-scan` reproduces this figure independently (12 across 7 final reports, 1 selected), confirming the hand-read line for line. ✎ Widened again to 14 across 7 on 2026-08-23 when #48 One Shot: Reloaded came out of judging and the owner supplied its report: two Highs (H-01 pseudo-randomness, H-04 battle-arena DoS), neither selected. #48's 'My Submissions' list had proposed 3H/1M/1L; the judge validated two Highs and nothing else, which is why this register counts reports and not submissions. Accounted: 14 of the profile's 17. These rows are 7H/4M/3L against the leaderboard's 8H/5M/4L, so the residual is exactly one High, one Medium and one Low — one contest whose report is not on disk, not an open-ended shortfall.
